title: United States Military Rail Road Photographic Album
institution: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division
stock: 108 albumen print photographs in one bound physical album, original digital page-turner and item-specific catalogued stock dimensions.
object_provenance: Library of Congress catalog traces the album through R. K. Hawley and General Winfield Scott Hancock; purchased in 2018 from 19th Century Rare Book & Photograph Shop.
page_number_rule: Page values are printed catalog page numbers, not IIIF canvas or presentation-sequence indices. Cross-map each catalog item to a downloaded canvas by title, text and visible image content before recording a file as a match.
rights_status: Page-38 print advisory verified. Verify album-level advisory and each other candidate asset. The MARC collection record documents original access on appointment for preservation.
